description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Plundering Barbarian.
When Plundering Barbarian enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, and Preston trigger twice if it has power 2 or less, or once otherwise.
Resolve both Plundering Barbarian triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Plundering Barbarian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Plundering Barbarian token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger, if applicable.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
